name: Posty Game
author: DylanBond
description: An innovative new 'posty' game inspired by the popular TV series Postman Pat. Please feel free to add feedback in this survey: https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=6fS7c4gGRkmuqb0LtA7PB_eQiz-q2LxFrRmLfwcCIN9UQTNNSzZKUDZDRVhVWE9JVVYyVFRLWUo4Ui4u. Thank you! Game mechanics: you a gain point when you collect a parcel and lose a point if you collide with a dog. The van can be controlled with WASD or the arrow keys.
